related_work:
This week, I started making the drawings for my Project 0.
I chose an electric toothbrush as my object. I want to take the toothbrush apart and show the audience what is inside it. I also want to introduce the different parts and their information, so people can understand the object better.
I also looked for some papers and information about electric toothbrushes. This helped me learn more about where the different parts come from and other information about the object.
I also made a mood board and found some images that I like. I will use these images as references for my project.

results_discussion:
One thing that surprised me about my Project 0 is that an electric toothbrush looks like a simple object, but it actually has many different materials, parts and production processes. After we use it, it is also not as simple as just throwing it away, because it contains batteries, plastic parts and other materials. I also found that some people can be harmed during the production process. These problems may not happen immediately, which made me think more about the hidden people and processes behind an everyday object.
In the tutorial class, we continued learning how to make a website. I still find it quite difficult, but Alice explained everything very carefully. She also showed us some examples that we could use as references and learn from.
title: week 2 in creative_tech_1
introduction:
This week, I learned more about websites and technology.
We talked about how software can change the way we work. I learned that tools can help us, but they can also change the way we think and make things. We also learned about the internet, such as data, servers and clients. We started learning about HTML, CSS and JavaScript. I learned that HTML is the structure of a website, CSS is for the style, and JavaScript is for making the website interactive. We also read  papers and looked at some examples. Then, we used the Tech Cards to think about our Project 0. We chose cards and thought about how the ideas on the cards could change our project or give us new ideas.
For my Project 0, I chose an electric toothbrush. I want to show information about its different parts, such as the brush head, case, motor and battery. The Tech Cards helped me think about my project in a different way. I started to think about how I could make the website more interesting and interactive, instead of only clicking on each part. 
It was also very interesting that Sam showed us some of his work. It made me more interested in this project and gave me more ideas to think about.
